visualReview: Compared all 72 source and candidate figures in their 8-column by 9-row arrangement. Each four-column cycle preserves front, back, image-right and image-left. Idle/walk silhouettes, overhead preparations, horizontal thrusts, vertical guards, crouched recovery and handed sword angles remain distinct in their original slots. Crimson long hair and black/red costume identity are preserved with newly drawn smooth ink contours and broad cel shading. No merged cells or omitted poses seen.
